description: Shared vectors of the sustained-cry trigger, written by `python -m cry_detector.make_vectors` (ml/cry_detector) from cry_detector/trigger.py; read by code/web/src/cry/trigger.test.ts. Window i starts at i * hopSeconds; startWindow = first active window of the sustained run (started_at), detectedAfterWindow = the window whose end fires the start, endWindow = last active window (ended_at = its end), closedWindows = when the end is known (in windows from the stream start; equal to `windows` when the stream ended first). Do not edit by hand.
